content:
Maya S.: Canary is backing up on payments-service in eu-west, steady increased pod restarts and deploy-bot shows backpressure on canary queue. Not hitting 5xx but latency spike.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] Canary rollout detected: payments-service v2.4.1 -> v2.5.0 (canary 10%). Health checks: passing=92/100, restarts=6 in 10m, error budget low. TTL: 00:45 remaining.
Maya S.: Logs show OOMs from worker pool during prefix-cache warmup. values override included a higher concurrency: `workers: 8` -> `12`.
Alice G.: Can we reduce canary fraction and bump replicaCount for canary pods? Prefer to avoid full rollback if possible.
Ben K.: Agree. Two levers: (A) pin chart to previous image (rollback) or (B) hotpatch values to reduce concurrency + increase pod replicas, then let canary finish. I vote B.
Carla D.: Hotpatch plan + quick smoke is fine. If latency > 2s after changes we rollback immediately.
Maya S.: Proposed hotpatch:
- Update values for canary release: `workers: 6`, `replicaCount: 3` for canary subset
- Reduce canary percent from 10 -> 5
- Trigger `helm upgrade --reuse-values --set canary.percent=5 --set canary.values.workers=6 --set canary.values.replicaCount=3 payments ./charts/payments -n services`
- Watch `kubectl rollout status deploy/payments-canary -n services` and `/api/health` latency for 10m
Deploy Bot: Can run canary adjustment if acknowledged by two owners.
Ben K.: Acknowledged. I'll run helm command once we get two approvals.
Alice G.: Ack. I'll monitor traces and slow query rate.
SRE Oncall: I'll stand by and be ready to scale the node pool if pod scheduling errors appear.
Carla D.: Adding note for release notes: "Incident mitigation: canary configuration adjusted (workers reduced, replicas increased) to address runtime memory pressure; image retained." I'll add a short blurb in the release-notes draft.
Maya S.: Ben, run the command now. Post the helm output here and the new canary percent when applied.
Ben K.: Running now...
Ben K.: ```
$ helm upgrade --reuse-values --set canary.percent=5 --set canary.values.workers=6 --set canary.values.replicaCount=3 payments ./charts/payments -n services
Release "payments" has been upgraded. Happy Helming!
``` 
Ben K.: `kubectl rollout status deploy/payments-canary -n services` -> rollout complete in 42s.
Alice G.: Traces: p95 latency dropped from 1.9s -> 0.95s after scale. No new restarts in 8m.
Maya S.: Good. Keep canary at 5% for 1h then re-evaluate. If stable, promote and update chart version in chartmuseum to mark hotpatch release.
Carla D.: I'll update release notes with the mitigation and add an entry for QA: "Verify payments throughput and memory profile post-hotpatch." Assigned to Alice.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] Canary percent changed to 5% by Ben K. Operator note: previous image preserved, chart version unchanged.
SRE Oncall: Observability checks green, node CPU 68%, mem pressure resolved.
Maya S.: Thanks team. If we see any spike revert plan: `helm rollback payments 1 --wait -n services` and open a rollback thread. For now leaving this thread open for post-1h verdict.
Alice G.: Will report back at `1704010476` with final smoke results.
Maya S.: closing note: assigned follow-up on promote decision to Ben. I will also add a brief postmortem note if we need to revisit worker defaults.
